item.title: Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud Join Smashing Pumpkins for Surprise Lollapalooza Set
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this special episode of Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, and today we're talking about a legendary performance by the Smashing Pumpkins at Lollapalooza. The Chicago-bred band headlined the festival for the first time in 32 years, and they brought some special guests along for the ride."
[Music transitions to a clip of Smashing Pumpkins]
Host: "Billy Corgan and the gang took the stage in Chicago, marking their first Lollapalooza headlining slot since 1994. But that's not all - they also brought out Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud as surprise guests to perform some classic nineties deep cuts."
[Music transitions to a clip of Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud]
Host: "Yungblud joined Corgan on stage to sing 'Luna' from the band's 1993 breakthrough album Siamese Dream. And then, Olivia Rodrigo took the stage to perform 'Thirty-Three' from the iconic 1995 album Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness. These pairings were more than just a fun collaboration - they represented a lineage of alternative rock that the Smashing Pumpkins helped pave the way for."
[Music transitions to a clip of Smashing Pumpkins' classic hits]
Host: "Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness remains the band's commercial high point, debuting at number one on the Billboard 200 in 1995 and eventually being certified diamond. And both Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud are carrying on that legacy, with Rodrigo's 2021 debut SOUR and 2023 follow-up GUTS both entering the Billboard 200 at number one, and Yungblud winning his first Grammy earlier this year."
[Music transitions to a clip of Olivia Rodrigo and Yungblud's music]
Host: "The guest spots capped off a week of nineties nostalgia, and it's clear that the Smashing Pumpkins are still going strong. We'll have to wait and see what's next for these music legends, but for now, let's just enjoy the music. Thanks for tuning in to this episode of Trending on Billboard - we'll catch you next time!"
[Outro music plays]
